goal: transcribe(faster_whisper): reset last_speech_timestamp per decode and enforce ignored no_speech/logprob segment gates (issue #69)

criteria.statement: self._pipeline.last_speech_timestamp is reset to 0.0 before every _pipeline.transcribe call in FasterWhisperEngine._decode
Silent segments (no_speech_prob > no_speech_threshold and avg_logprob < log_prob_threshold) are dropped before _words_of emits tokens
FasterWhisperEngine unit tests and regression engine tests pass
